findings.explanation: A signed-in user can change the protected column "paid" on their own row in the table "accounts".
findings.fix: Stop users from updating "paid" on "accounts": take update permission on that column away from the signed-in role (revoke update, then grant update only on the columns users may change), or move it to a table users cannot write.

proof.statement: UPDATE "public"."accounts" SET "paid" = NOT "paid" WHERE "paid" IS DISTINCT FROM NOT "paid"
